description: Vedic birth chart (Kundli) at a glance from date, time and place of birth: rising sign (lagna), Moon sign (rashi), nakshatra, the planet period (Vimshottari dasha) running now, and where each planet sits. Use when someone asks about their chart, rashi, nakshatra or dasha.

birth_place.description: Town or city of birth with country, e.g. "Hyderabad, India".

birth_time.description: Time of birth as 24-hour HH:MM, local time at the birth place. Leave out if unknown (the rising sign and houses are then skipped).

name.description: First name, if the person gave one.

name: read_kundli
title: Read my Kundli
